calls.reason: Li, Nye and Andreas found editable state representations but limited recovery accuracy; the chess study showed specialized state tracking. Neither settles reliable use of cognitive models in the language systems Marcus discussed.

Araujo and colleagues’ 2021 work explicitly used cognitive theories of predictive processing and discourse comprehension to change BERT-style architecture and training. That undermines the blanket claim that the approach ignores this literature.

Bender and Koller offer a theoretical argument against meaning from text alone; Mandelkern and Linzen challenge that reasoning without claiming resolution. Neither establishes reference or its absence in the historical systems.
